name: R044-superpower-atk-minus3-swagger
why: The player's Registeel (set 841) uses Superpower every turn; its White Herb undoes the first drop (Clear Body does not block a self-drop, MOVE_EFFECT_CERTAIN), so after four Superpowers its Attack is at -3. The opponent's Hypno (set 593: Psych Up, Swagger, Mega Kick, Shadow Ball) resists Fighting and survives. From turn 5 AI_CV_Swagger takes its Psych Up branch with the target's Attack at -3 or lower (+3, turn count in the result register).
